senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; שָׁאַר to swell, rise; cmp. שְׂאוֹר) baking trough or dish. Tanḥ. Vaëra 14 (ref. to Ex. VII, 28) אימתי מ׳ מצויה וכ׳ when is the trough near the oven?

(שָׁאַר to remain) remainder.—Pl. מִשְׁאָרוֹת. Mekh. Bo s. 13 (ref. to משארתם, Ex. XII, 34; v. Targ.) אלו שיורי מצה ומרור that means the remnants of the unleavened bread and the bitter herbs (of the Passover meal); Tanḥ. Bo 8.
